title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Joshua 2: the two spies, Rahab of Jericho, and the scarlet thread in the window.

questions.text: From where did Joshua secretly send two men as spies?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies.

answers.text: Gilgal
Shittim
Bethel
Hebron

questions.text: What was the name of the woman in whose house the spies stayed?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says they came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.

answers.text: Deborah
Miriam
Rahab
Ruth

questions.text: Where did Rahab hide the spies?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says she brought them up to the roof and hid them under the stalks of flax she had laid in order there.

answers.text: Under stalks of flax on the roof
In a cellar under the floor
In a well in the courtyard
Behind the city gate

questions.text: Along which way did the men pursue the spies?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River.

answers.text: Along the road down toward the Red Sea
Along the way back to the land of Egypt
Along the road up to the city of Ai
Along the way to the fords of the Jordan River

questions.text: Which two kings of the Amorites does Rahab say they had heard about?
questions.explanation: Rahab says they heard what Israel did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og.

answers.text: Pharaoh and Balak
Adoni-zedek and Jabin
Sihon and Og
Agag and Eglon

questions.text: What did Rahab ask the spies to swear by Yahweh?
questions.explanation: She asked them to swear that they would deal kindly with her father's house and save her family alive.

answers.text: That they would make her queen of Jericho
That they would deal kindly with her father's house
That they would take her to Joshua that night
That they would spare the king of Jericho

questions.text: How did Rahab let the spies down?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says she let them down by a cord through the window, for her house was on the side of the wall.

answers.text: Through the city gate at night
By a ladder over the wall
In a basket from the roof
By a cord through the window

questions.text: How long did Rahab tell the spies to hide on the mountain?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says: "Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned."

answers.text: Three days
One day
Seven days
Forty days

questions.text: What was Rahab to tie in the window?
questions.explanation: The men told her to tie "this line of scarlet thread in the window" through which she let them down.

answers.text: A strip of white linen cloth
A line of scarlet thread
A cord of blue and purple
A branch from a palm tree

questions.text: What did the spies say to Joshua when they returned?
questions.explanation: Verse 24 says they told Joshua, "Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands."

answers.text: "The people are too strong and tall for us"
"The walls of Jericho can never be taken"
"Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands"
"We could not find a way into the city"
